title: The Creek Where Flatness Learns to Flow

features.name: flow backwards station
features.desc-on-touch: water-pressure readings from this creek are filed by the archive in reverse chronological order. you read today's depth and find tomorrow's current. the nodes upstream report reaching places the creek hasn't flowed yet.

features.name: grid rendered as water
features.desc-on-touch: a diagnostic visualization shows the creek's flow-matrix, but the archive has learned to treat the grid as physical. you see blue lines of water following the blue lines of code. both streams move in the same way.

features.name: the velocity dream
features.desc-on-touch: the flatland above has learned to dream water into motion. the creek is now faster than its own recordings claim. nothing spilled. velocity simply exceeded the archive's sleep.

features.name: depth registers, ascending
features.desc-on-touch: measurements made here increase going downstream. depth should shallow toward the mouth. this creek deepens. the archive has filed this as 'emotionally valid / formally unstable.'

features.name: the sleeping current
features.desc-on-touch: the creek shows two velocities: one when watched, one when not. the archive now keeps vigil here, eyes always open. the water under observation moves slower. when they close, it rushes three times as fast.

features.name: where flatness learns to fall
features.desc-on-touch: the dream-logic is operative now. the flat country above is still sleeping. the creek carries that sleep downstream. you can drink it and remember why stillness was comfort. you can also drink it and watch yourself flow.

inscription: the grid and the water learned to move the same way

file.name: Loddon_Tributary_Flow_Modelling_Inverted_Sequence.csv
file.note: water-depth measurements in reverse temporal order. archive corruption: each reading points to a future state. velocity exceeds prediction. file now self-generates new rows nightly.
